verdict.rationale: Gitleaks' official gitleaks-action runs scans automatically on a team's pull requests and comments on PRs, and the baseline feature limits reported findings to new ones only. However, the pack never documents exit-code behavior or that a finding fails the CI build; the only 'Failed' output shown is from the pre-commit hook. missing for 10: documented non-zero exit codes on findings, explicit CI build-failure behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of PR gating.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run scans in CI on every pull request and fail the build on new findings via exit codes

citations.quote: You can use it to automatically run a gitleaks scan on all your team's pull requests and commits, or run on-demand scans.
**gitleaks-action** uses this token to call [a GitHub API] to comment on PRs.
After running the detect command with the --baseline-path parameter, report output (findings.json) will only contain new issues.
When using a baseline, gitleaks will ignore any old findings that are present in the baseline.
